job: Define absolute-protection actuator authority and detector tolerance before implementing the monitor
scope: Forced-on DC authority only. No detector, LED supply, delay, thermal, reversal or physical proof.
done_condition: Independent current-balance and source preservation checks; reject insufficient control paths; retain required detector window.
human_evidence: Exact parts, hot control authority, transient overshoot and reversal must be verified before adopting the protection.
effort: One bounded actuator and detector-window wave
limitations: VTO=-5 is an allocated cutoff sensitivity, not a guaranteed hot transistor limit. Fixed KP and generic clamps remain surrogates.
The direct current sink is an interface requirement, not a qualified optocoupler/transistor circuit.
Control is forced on. A low forced-on equilibrium does not prove automatic fault detection or a peak-voltage bound.
An independent detector must be powered and operational through startup, faults and input collapse.

sources.fact: DIP4 VO618A CTR minimum50percent at1mA LED and5V collector; saturation maximum0.4V at1mA LED/0.25mA collector,25C. These do not establish hot saturation at the required actuator current.
TL431B initial Vref2483–2507mV at25C/10mA; BI full-temperature deviation up to34mV. Typical drift cannot be used as a guaranteed trip bound.
